title: Audit matched P104 source-return adapters and their 192-ADD difference
body:
## Result and scope

Closes the released [PR3943 handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19032700) to match its 960-ADD source-return adapter against PR3940's 1152-ADD adapter before comparing them.

At the same encoded entrance, fixed physical outputs, formal chart semantics, unit arithmetic alphabet and 72 arbitrary dirty helpers, the existing PR3943 word saves exactly **192 unit Gaussian array additions**. Both words use 104 halves, 104 restoring doubles and 192 rank-one transports. The difference is two rather than four direct updates for each of 96 nonpivot pairs; both retain the same two 384-entry B traversals.

This is an independent comparative audit, not a newly discovered return construction or scalar optimum. Recursive rank mass is unchanged. PR3940's different fused 208-H1/mass-2576 suffix is not contradicted. No supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier change.

## Evidence

Scientific head: `f73eef845623a42363ec8d883058fab98fb1335d`; canonical base `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority 6. Exactly 11 added files under `research/p104-return-contract-match/`. Public root tree `87d61024cb9d2e8c23885fd632eb4ecb90b0cd48` equals the locally tested tree; the public delta is one commit.

- Five unchanged source exports with hardcoded SHA256 checks and recorded original Git blobs.
- Actual pinned predecessor schedule builders, with an independently written Fraction evaluator and inverse equations: all 280 encoded basis inputs, chart obligations, 72 helper returns and complete invoices pass.
- Separate dense symbolic block identities on five rectangular/rational B examples; nine destructive controls, including an unchanged endpoint rejected solely for understating two added operations.
- Normal/optimized checks, Git-free read-only export, registered Python 3.12 replay and publication-byte/source-history preflight pass. Source-builder reuse is explicit; neither predecessor arithmetic evaluator is imported. No independent human/kernel review is claimed.

Reproduce, standard library Python 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-return-contract-match
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-return-contract-match --check-source-history
```

Local package replay takes about one second on CPython 3.12.14; runtime is host-dependent. Hosted CI is separate and initially pending.

## Selection, overlap and remaining obligations

Handoff-first refinement of `p104-side-correction`, with an advance claim on PR3943. Main refreshed at entry and before submission; 654 open PR bodies including drafts checked at entry, then all 657 refreshed across seven pages and the repository overlap helper rerun. Live #1166/#1163 reads are bounded, not a complete Discussion/closed-diff survey. New PR3954 explicitly excludes this comparison and updates the downstream two-axis task; its claims are context, not freshly replayed evidence.

The complete original channel, actual binary hyperplane/native/global-phase realization, signed-floor precision, physical owners/holding/routing/control/tapes, opposite orientation, selected cold replay and full supplier admission remain unrun/unproved. The adapter comparison uses the predecessors' formal encoded entrance. Stop this comparison and release the claim; further scalar optimization does not repair the failed recursive allowance. The next consequential task needs a changed all-role encoding/consumer and a favorable complete invoice beyond PR3954's rejected scaffold.

Credit parallel PR3954 and the retained Rohan Arun/PR1972, Chafik Boukhalfa/PR1991, Adam Gall/PR1940, terminal-floor/occupancy, Josie Elliston/E8, Sagar Thakrar/PR1012, Douglas Colkitt, Dominik Scholz and caller/native/compiler lineage. Full notices and exact source pins remain in the package.

New comparative audit and checks by ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate AI algebra review/test implementation. Apache-2.0. Maintainer edits disabled; no merge or frontier change.
